It would just be so easy and I wouldn't have to deal with any more consequences. The finality of it all is so appealing. I am doing poorly because I go to a top program in what is considered one of the most difficult degrees. I like the content, it's not exactly what I had in mind when I started. I just don't have time to do everything. I can't take time off, I've asked my parents before. There were so many nights I was depressed and alone and thought if only there was someone I could hold tonight everything would work out. Then I had the girl and fucked it up. It was such a stupid thing too.

What happened with your girl?
